limitation: Ground truth is synthetic, not observational physical truth.
consequence: Limits claims to controlled simulations.
mandatory_manuscript_qualification: Use synthetic-ground-truth wording.

limitation: The primary synthetic signal family is frozen by the F3B.1 generator contract.
consequence: Other QPP morphologies are not covered.
mandatory_manuscript_qualification: Do not generalize to arbitrary QPP waveforms.

limitation: True-period support is restricted to 40–300 s.
consequence: Performance outside this range is uncharacterized.
mandatory_manuscript_qualification: State period support when discussing recovery.

limitation: Durations/sample counts, red-noise slopes and signal strengths lie on a discrete frozen grid.
consequence: The selection function is not a continuous population law.
mandatory_manuscript_qualification: Describe a stratified empirical surface.

limitation: The 720 input-admissibility challenges are a designed diagnostic plane, not a population sample.
consequence: Their aggregate fraction is not observational prevalence.
mandatory_manuscript_qualification: Keep challenge metrics separate.

limitation: Synthetic nulls do not exhaust observational background behavior.
consequence: Real background mismatch can alter false-selection behavior.
mandatory_manuscript_qualification: Do not transport FPR directly to TESS.

limitation: HELDOUT synthetic sensitivity is low: 152/1800.
consequence: Many injected QPP signals are not selected.
mandatory_manuscript_qualification: Report low sensitivity with high specificity.

limitation: HELDOUT observed 0/1800 false selections.
consequence: Zero count retains finite-sample uncertainty.
mandatory_manuscript_qualification: Give Wilson interval; do not claim population FPR=0.

limitation: The 156-row final selection function is valid only on the frozen synthetic domain.
consequence: No observational population correction follows automatically.
mandatory_manuscript_qualification: Transport requires F4+ evidence.

limitation: Period-error metrics condition on selected true positives with finite recovered period.
consequence: They do not summarize all injected positives.
mandatory_manuscript_qualification: Do not interpret good period accuracy as completeness.

limitation: Extra-seed stability was assessed only in DEVELOPMENT.
consequence: HELDOUT stability was not rerun by design.
mandatory_manuscript_qualification: Do not imply HELDOUT multi-seed evidence.

limitation: Numerical stability does not establish a unique global optimum.
consequence: Optimizer-level uncertainty is bounded.
mandatory_manuscript_qualification: Avoid unique-optimum claims.

limitation: Execution is bound to AFINO 0.5 and its frozen environment/commit.
consequence: Other versions are outside this evidence.
mandatory_manuscript_qualification: Report frozen implementation identity.

limitation: Candidate development was restricted to the frozen two-threshold family.
consequence: Alternative classifier families were not explored.
mandatory_manuscript_qualification: Do not claim arbitrary-rule optimality.

limitation: The DEVELOPMENT optimum failed the preregistered specificity-preservation gate.
consequence: Final rule remains baseline.
mandatory_manuscript_qualification: Do not rescue a runner-up post hoc.

limitation: External comparator methods were not executed in F3B.8.
consequence: Closure is not a benchmark against every detector.
mandatory_manuscript_qualification: Do not claim comparative superiority.

limitation: HELDOUT is consumed as a single-use validation set.
consequence: It cannot support new rule development without circularity.
mandatory_manuscript_qualification: Future tuning requires new independent data.

limitation: No calibration maps the synthetic design distribution to the real TESS population.
consequence: Population prevalence and correction are not established.
mandatory_manuscript_qualification: Reserve transport/correction for F4+.

limitation: Synthetic classification performance does not establish the physical origin of observed variability.
consequence: Physical QPP truth remains separate.
mandatory_manuscript_qualification: Do not convert classifier outcomes into physical proof.

limitation: F0, F1, F2, F3A and F3B answer different evidence questions.
consequence: Collapsing them into one validation label overstates scope.
mandatory_manuscript_qualification: Keep evidence planes separate in Manuscript 1.

limitation: DEVELOPMENT and HELDOUT are compared descriptively without pooling/equivalence/hypothesis testing.
consequence: Similarity is qualitative, not formal equivalence.
mandatory_manuscript_qualification: Do not claim statistical equivalence.
